remarks: Welcome home to this charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment featuring gleaming hardwood floors and a spacious living area perfect for both everyday living and entertaining guests. Natural light pours in, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The large bedroom easily accommodates a queen-sized bed with room to spare for a desk or reading nook - ideal for anyone working from home or craving a peaceful retreat.  Located just minutes from shops, restaurants, and entertainment, with quick access to I-95 and the train, commuting into NYC is seamless and stress-free. Whether you're a professional seeking convenience or simply want to enjoy all that the area has to offer, this well-appointed apartment offers comfort, space, and unbeatable location.
